item.content: {"url": "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=path+dependence+preference+formation+multi-agent+reinforcement+learning+stochastic+initial+conditions&format=json&resultType=core&pageSize=4", "scope": "Europe PMC search metadata, abstracts and full-text links; discovery only", "excerpt": "[{\"title\": \"Space–Air–Ground Integrated Networks for Smart Agriculture and Smart Breeding: A Review of SDN/NFV-Enabled Intelligent Resource Management\", \"abstract\": null, \"doi\": null, \"pmid\": \"PMC13667718\", \"pmcid\": \"PMC13667718\", \"source\": \"PMC\", \"fullTextUrlList\": {\"fullTextUrl\": [{\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"html\", \"site\": \"PubMedCentral\", \"url\": \"https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC13667718/?tool=EBI\"}, {\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"pdf\", \"site\": \"PubMedCentral\", \"url\": \"https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC13667718/pdf/?tool=EBI\"}, {\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"html\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC13667718\"}, {\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"pdf\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC13667718?pdf=render\"}]}}, {\"title\": \"Scarcity-Coefficient Gated Projection Reinforcement Learning for Planning-Layer Capacity Activation in Emergency Wireless Networks.\", \"abstract\": \"After infrastructure disruption, an emergency wireless controller must meet urgent communication demand and preserve resources for later periods. We propose Scarcity-Coefficient Gated Projection Reinforcement Learning (SCGP-RL). It jointly selects total planning-layer activation and a regional capacity upper-bound vector. Scarcity and urgent-demand evidence shape the activation intent. Scalar and capped-simplex projections enforce the coupled action constraints. A planning capacity unit (PCU) is defined as a calibratable service-capacity quantum. In the common constrained evaluation, SCGP-RL reduced the unmet urgent-demand score from 0.6643 for Projected CPO to 0.4919. It also satisfied all the executed hard constraints.
